# sonarqube_alm_azure (Resource)

A Azure DevOps DevOps platform setting. Every attribute changes in place. Destroying a setting that projects are still bound to is refused, because SonarQube would remove their bindings with it. Import ID: the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The *_wo arguments keep credentials out of state (Terraform 1.11+).
# Change credentials_wo_version to apply new values.
resource "sonarqube_alm_azure" "main" {
  key                      = "azure-devops"
  url                      = "https://dev.azure.com/example-org"
  personal_access_token_wo = var.azure_pat
  credentials_wo_version   = "1"
}

variable "azure_pat" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Unique key of the setting. Changing it renames the setting in place, keeping its project bindings.
- `url` (String) Azure DevOps collection URL.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `credentials_wo_version` (String) Any value; changing it applies the current values of the `_wo` arguments.
- `personal_access_token` (String, Sensitive) Azure DevOps personal access token. Stored in state; prefer `personal_access_token_wo`. SonarQube does not return it, so drift cannot be detected.
- `personal_access_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only form of `personal_access_token`, never stored in state (Terraform 1.11+). Change `credentials_wo_version` to apply a new value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The setting key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_alm_azure.example 'azure-devops'
```
